notes.title: She Doesn't Walk - Patch 01
notes.content:
Thank you to all who've purchased (and kept) She Doesn't Walk!
I'm releasing my first patch and it should be live sometime within the next 24 hours. 
Below are some of the things I've updated.

David

Update Notes - V2
01/23/2021

Bugs fixed
- Start screen clickable only once.
- Fixed lantern icon. Icon lit up when clicking the dropped lantern.
- Door ignores boxes now.
- Normals issue on bird's nest fixed.
- Fixed capsule collision and navmesh issues for "Her", no more landscape clipping.
 
Gameplay improvements
- Made step ladder non-interactive to encourage other exploration.
- Slowed the auto turning a touch.
- Brightened the environment just a little. 
- Strengthened Lights on interactable objects things (planks, bricks, etc.) 
- Removed the need for the bolt cutters a second time.
- Improved the functionality of the plank, the player can no longer "surf".
- Improved grass footstep sound effect, removed the "popping."
